modules.title: 下游变慢时，为什么要把信号传回上游
背压让工作量跟着处理能力变化

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: 上传持续快于图片处理会让队列、未完成任务和内存上涨；下游变慢或达到上限时，把反馈传回上游，让它放慢、暂停或暂时不接新工作。

items.title: 用恢复证据判断改善
items.text: 模拟高峰后，队列和内存应保持有界，处理能力恢复时上游能继续；背压不是凭空增加容量，也不是固定限流规则。

items.title: 财务报表导出也会出现背压
items.text: 批量导出报表时，数据读取如果快于文件写入，写入端接近容量上限就通知读取端暂停，腾出空间后再继续，避免导出进程因缓冲持续增长而耗尽内存。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 扩容是在增加处理能力，固定限流是在规定统一速率；背压强调下游状态怎样反馈给上游。它不能消除处理失败，仍需保留失败状态和恢复路径。

lessonPractice.title: 图片处理速度低于上传速度，队列长度和内存都在上涨。哪种改法是在使用背压？

options.label: 根据下游处理能力暂停或放慢上游发送，并限制未完成任务数量
options.feedback: 对。背压把下游过慢的反馈传回上游，让未完成工作量保持在可控范围。

options.label: 只把队列容量调大，让更多任务先堆在内存里
options.feedback: 容量变大只能延后暴露问题，不能让上游感知下游已经处理不过来。

options.label: 无论下游状态如何，永久把所有用户限制为同一个固定速率
options.feedback: 这是固定限流的思路，不是根据下游反馈动态调整工作流。

en.title: Image processing is slower than uploads, and queue length and memory are rising. Which change uses backpressure?

options.label: Pause or slow publishing based on downstream capacity, and cap unfinished work
options.feedback: Correct. Backpressure sends the downstream slowdown back upstream and keeps unfinished work bounded.

options.label: Only make the queue larger so more work can accumulate in memory
options.feedback: More capacity delays the symptom but does not tell the upstream that downstream is overloaded.

options.label: Permanently give every user the same fixed rate regardless of downstream state
options.feedback: That is fixed rate limiting, not adapting the flow from downstream feedback.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 为图片处理链路补上背压：当下游处理变慢或未完成任务达到上限时，让上游暂停或限速；恢复后再继续。模拟上传速度超过处理速度的情况，验收队列和内存不会无限增长，并记录触发和恢复的反馈。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add backpressure to the image-processing path: when downstream processing slows or unfinished work reaches its limit, pause or slow the upstream; resume after recovery. Simulate uploads faster than processing and verify that queue and memory do not grow without bound, with trigger and recovery feedback recorded.

learning.assumes: You have seen work pile up, processing slow down, or service memory rise.
learning.outcome: You can tell when downstream slowness should feed back upstream and distinguish backpressure from scaling and fixed rate limiting.

modules.title: Why send a downstream slowdown back to the upstream?
Backpressure makes work follow processing capacity

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: When uploads outpace image processing, queue length, unfinished work, and memory rise; when downstream slows or reaches its limit, the system sends that feedback upstream so the producer slows down, pauses, or temporarily stops accepting work.

items.title: Judge improvement by recovery evidence
items.text: After a simulated peak, queue and memory should stay bounded and publishing should resume when capacity returns. Backpressure does not add capacity or become a fixed rate rule.

items.title: Financial report exports also need backpressure
items.text: During a bulk report export, data reading may outpace file writing. As the writer nears its capacity limit, it tells the reader to pause and resume after space is available, preventing the export process from exhausting memory as its buffer grows.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Scaling adds processing capacity; fixed rate limiting sets one rate. Backpressure is about downstream state feeding upstream. It does not remove processing failures, so failure and recovery paths still matter.

distinctions.label: Rate Limiting
distinctions.text: {c:rate-limit} blocks requests exceeding fixed thresholds; {c:backpressure} lets downstream dynamically signal upstream to slow down based on current load.
